# Caddy – compiled-in Go modules

This list is generated during the build by `build/fetch-thirdparty.ps1` from `WEBit-Caddy.exe build-info`.
Each module is linked to its license and copyright notice on pkg.go.dev.

To view the list for the installed binary at any time:

```
bin\caddy\WEBit-Caddy.exe build-info
```

Sources of all modules: https://github.com/caddyserver/caddy (`go.mod`, `go.sum`).
